title: setup hook then setup hook --remove on a project with no .claude leaves no .claude behind
source: intended: docs/decisions.md D8 (setup hook, defect N-17): jitso registers its guard in the project's .claude/settings.json without clobbering anything
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-17, setup hook). The file jitso created is deleted by `--remove` (the document becomes `{}`), and the `.claude/` folder with it when it is then empty. The oracle has no `setup` command: it answers `unknown command "setup"` on stderr with exit 2 and prints nothing on stdout, so every expectation that needs this output or file effect FAILS on it.
